headline: Unicommerce Esolutions appoints Prankur Chaturvedi as Company Secretary
hook: New compliance head at Unicommerce Esolutions
summary: Unicommerce Esolutions Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Prankur Chaturvedi as the Company Secretary of the firm, effective October 23, 2026. Company Secretaries handle key regulatory compliance, corporate governance, and legal filings for listed entities. This is a routine administrative change for the company and has no direct material impact on its financial performance. Indian retail investors tracking the stock should note this standard leadership transition in the secretarial department.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no financial impact.

headline: Unicommerce Q2 profit grows 11% to ₹6.4 Cr
hook: Double-digit growth for Unicommerce in Q2
summary: Unicommerce reported a consolidated net profit of ₹6.4 Cr for the September quarter of FY27, marking an 11% year-on-year increase. Revenue from operations rose 15% during the same period. The ecommerce SaaS provider continues to see growth as it scales its platform services. This performance reflects the company's ongoing expansion in the retail technology sector.
why_it_matters: Steady earnings growth supports current valuation for retail shareholders.

headline: Unicommerce partners with Kenstar to boost online sales
hook: Kenstar taps Unicommerce for e-commerce expansion
summary: Unicommerce Esolutions has entered a partnership with consumer durables brand Kenstar. The collaboration aims to streamline Kenstar's e-commerce operations and support its digital growth strategy. Unicommerce will provide its technology platform to manage Kenstar's multi-channel online sales. This deal expands Unicommerce's client base in the consumer electronics sector.
why_it_matters: New client wins strengthen Unicommerce's revenue growth prospects.
